/* selectSellerMpClCatalogRecharterMngList */ SELECT X.* FROM ( SELECT A.RC_NO , A.RC_SEQ , A.REVISION , A.AGENT , A.BUYER ,(SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = A.BUYER) AS BUYER_NM , A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO , A.CONTRACT_NO , A.CONTRACT_SEQ , A.RC_TYPE , (SELECT COD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'RC01' AND COD.CODE = A.RC_TYPE) AS RC_TEXT , A.ATOB_DATE , A.ATOS_DATE , A.STOA_DATE , A.CLOSE_DATE , A.STOA_CLOSE_DATE , A.UNIT_PRICE , A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE , A.LIST_PRICE , A.STOA_LIST_PRICE , A.A_NOTE , B.DESCRIPTION_LOC , B.SPECIFICATION , B.ORIGIN_CODE , (SELECT COD.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = B.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_NM , C.MAKER_NAME , C.UNIT_MEASURE , C.MAKER_PART_NO , C.MIN_ORDER_QTY , C.PUR_UNIT_QTY , A.CHANGE_USER_ID , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = A.CHANGE_USER_ID) USER_NM , (SELECT USR.PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = A.CHANGE_USER_ID) USER_PHONE_NUMBER , NVL(D.RATE_GUBUN,'B') AS RATE_GUBUN , NVL(D.RATE, 3) AS RATE , (SELECT COD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'CC01' AND COD.CODE = A.G_NOTE) AS G_NOTE , A.S_NOTE FROM KEP_RCDT A, ICOMBYIT B, ICOMCQDT C, KEP_BUYER_RATE D WHERE A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = C.BUYER AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO AND A.CONTRACT_SEQ = C.CONTRACT_SEQ AND A.BUYER = D.BUYER(+) AND A.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND C.STATUS != 'D' AND A.RC_TYPE != 'O' AND A.ATOS_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND A.RC_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_rc_no}||'%'
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_buyer_item_no}||'%'
AND B.DESCRIPTION_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_desc}||'%'
AND B.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%'||#{st_sepc}||'%'
AND C.MAKER_PART_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_maker_part_no}||'%'
ORDER BY A.RC_NO, A.RC_SEQ )X WHERE 1=1
AND REPLACE(UPPER(X.BUYER_NM),' ','') LIKE '%'||UPPER(TRIM(REPLACE(#{st_buyer_name},' ','')))||'%'
